data.description:
## Context / Problem

Epic `outrageous-uncultured-wildebeast` (`0e68-41eb-5782-4336`, "Many-to-many tracker projects")
has a **10,135-character** description. Commit `7cf80009d9` ("Block oversized ticket descriptions
before review") introduced an **8,000-character admission cap** (P4) that refuses a plan review
outright, so `rebar review-plan 0e68-41eb-5782-4336` now returns a single blocking finding —
"Ticket description exceeds the review admission limit" — and cannot produce an attestation.

Because the epic is `open` and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, the **parent-first claim
cascade** means *no child of this epic can be claimed at all*. Concretely, `rebar claim
bloated-shadeful-lamprey` fails with "claiming its parent 0e68-41eb-5782-4336 failed first", even
though that child holds a fresh certified PASS attestation of its own. The epic's own three
`depends_on` prerequisites are all closed, so nothing else stands in the way.

The epic's description predates the cap; it is not defective, merely over a limit introduced after
it was authored.

## Approach

The epic's owner shortens the description to at most 8,000 characters — per the gate's own
suggested fix, by moving independent work into coherent child tickets rather than by deleting
content — then runs `rebar review-plan` to earn the attestation that unblocks the cascade.

This ticket is deliberately **not** actioned by the agent that discovered it: rewriting an
in-flight epic's description is that epic owner's call, and the material change would invalidate
any plan-review attestation already held by its other children.

## Scope

No repository files change. The edit is to rebar ticket `0e68-41eb-5782-4336`'s description in the
ticket store.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `0e68-41eb-5782-4336`'s description is at most 8,000 characters; checked by reading the
      ticket and measuring the description length.
- [ ] `rebar review-plan 0e68-41eb-5782-4336` admits the plan — no P4 admission finding; checked
      by running it and confirming the blocking list contains no P4 entry.
- [ ] A child of the epic can be claimed without the parent cascade failing; checked by running
      `rebar claim bloated-shadeful-lamprey` and confirming it exits 0.
data.title: Oversized epic description blocks the parent-first claim cascade
